No base has been added yet, so no reaction has occurred. The pH depends only on the (initial) concentration of the strong acid (which completely dissociates into hydronium ion and its conjugate base).
In this region, the initial moles of strong acid are greater than the added moles of strong base. The pH is determined from the concentration of unneutralized strong acid (moles of unreacted H

In this region, the moles of added strong base are greater than the initial moles of strong acid. The pH is determined from the concentration of excess strong base (moles of unreacted OH
divided by total volume of solution).

When a strong base (the analyte) is titrated with a strong acid (the titrant), the pH at any given point in the titration also depends on the relative amounts of both species.
